scope: Source-backed legacy menus and attributed LOCAL Jem quest persistence/exchange. Official progress UI and reward ordering UNKNOWN.

boundaries.classic_confirmed: 확보한 UML action/stem·CSV 대사와 catalog 이름/토큰/ID만 확인. 실제 NPC 발급·화면·공식 수량·보상은 미확인.
boundaries.local_policy: 수량 1개와 아래 보상·직업/레벨은 L1J 출처의 계산 후보. 명시 policy=l1j_local에서만 소비/보상 DATA 제안. 기본 Classic 계산은 지급을 제안하지 않는다.
boundaries.action_mismatch: Classic queststart/questcomplete는 L1J request ...와 다르다. action 문자열을 서로 대체하거나 L1J 숫자를 wire ID로 쓰지 않는다.
boundaries.identity: npc_key는 자료 식별자이며 live UID가 아니다. Classic template 후보도 실제 메뉴 발급 연결의 증명이 아니다.
boundaries.acceptance: Pure calculations require explicit reference_steps. LOCAL runtime initializes a missing Level15 to0 in the acceptance save; existing steps are preserved. End=255 follows L1Quest.java:64. This is separate from the existing SHOP participant/issuer store.
boundaries.repeatability: L1J first exchange is repeatable; this runtime retains one acceptance/completion per character. No reset/reaccept. After completion the next queststart selects existing jem9/4/10 pages.
boundaries.runtime: world_feature_quest/QuestStore persist per-character acceptance, current collection progress, completion and class-scoped Level15. Turn-in commits existing kit inventory and world_progress with forward recovery before responding. No 05xx progress/tip packets: their link to legacy menus is UNKNOWN (run405).
boundaries.experience: Jem Quest.xml:401-414 contains only item exchange. Explicit LOCAL additional EXP=0; this does not prove zero official Classic EXP. Positive EXP policy uses world_reward growth and world_progress in the same turn-in transaction.
